channel.title: Keep or Cancel: A Subscription Check-In
channel.description:
One-minute episodes to help you decide which subscriptions to keep, which to cancel first, and when to act before the next charge. General money tips, not financial advice.

Made by Honest Little Apps, the makers of MoneyShield: Sub Tracker, an iPhone app that shows your subscriptions, renewal dates and which to cancel first. MoneyShield: Sub Tracker on the App Store

Narrated with a synthetic (text-to-speech) voice.
